import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# Define colors for species
species_colors = {'setosa': '#1f77b4', 'versicolor': '#ff7f0e', 'virginica': '#2ca02c'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=species, color=species_colors[species])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', fontsize=10)

# 2. Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=species, color=species_colors[species])
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', fontsize=10)

# 3. Box plot: Feature distributions by species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
features = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']
feature_names = ['Sepal Length', 'Sepal Width', 'Petal Length', 'Petal Width']
box_data = []
for feature in features:
    box_data.append(df[feature])
positions = np.arange(len(features)) * (len(df['species'].unique()) + 1) + 1

bp = ax3.boxplot(box_data, positions=positions, widths=0.6, patch_artist=True)
colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728']
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax3.set_xticks(positions)
ax3.set_xticklabels(feature_names, fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of All Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add legend for box plot
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=colors[0], alpha=0.7, label='Sepal Length'),
                   Patch(facecolor=colors[1], alpha=0.7, label='Sepal Width'),
                   Patch(facecolor=colors[2], alpha=0.7, label='Petal Length'),
                   Patch(facecolor=colors[3], alpha=0.7, label='Petal Width')]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_elements, fontsize=10, title='Features')

# 4. Violin plot: Petal measurements comparison
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
violin_data = pd.melt(df, id_vars=['species'], value_vars=['petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                      var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
violin_data['measurement'] = violin_data['measurement'].replace({'petal_length': 'Petal Length', 
                                                                 'petal_width': 'Petal Width'})
sns.violinplot(x='measurement', y='value', hue='species', data=violin_data, 
               palette=species_colors, ax=ax4, split=True, inner='quartile')
ax4.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_title('Petal Measurements Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Species', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset Analysis: Flower Measurements by Species', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
